name: mla_online_softmax_with_lse
description: Two-stage online softmax: per-split tracking (Stage 1) + cross-split reduction via LSE (Stage 2)
steps: Stage 1: maintain per-head (rmax, rsum) across KV tiles within each split
On each new tile: rescale = exp(old_max - new_max), rsum *= rescale
Output partial O and LSE = rmax + log(rsum) per split
Stage 2 (Triton): load all splits, find global max LSE
Combine: O_final = sum(exp(lse_i - lse_max) * O_i) / sum(exp(lse_i - lse_max))
expected_impact: Numerically stable attention for arbitrary context lengths with split-KV parallelism
